name: Two unsigned, unaddressed cipher letters for the Constantinople legation, one dated 9 Feb 1809 (DECODE R1469, 7 pp.) and one undated (R1470, 6 pp.); DECODE attributes them to W.F. Roell -> F.G. van Dedem van de Gelder, Bourdeau doubts it (Van Dedem to G. Testa fits the French 'Monsieur' better). Schmeh's Top-25 no.10, 'Das Van-Gelder-Kryptogramm' (Cipherbrain, 8 Aug 2013, from Karl de Leeuw)
ciphertext_source: DECODE R1469/R1470 transcription (SofPe, 2 Feb 2020) as parsed by D. Bourdeau's parse.py (cyphersolver targets/roell1809, MIT), copied 2 Oct 2026; group list only, marks and uncertain digits dropped, no line breaks. DECODE's shelfmark 'legatie Turkije inv. 804' is wrong on both counts: the toegang is 1.02.20 (scARCH, 24 Sept 2026) and inv. 804 holds clear Dutch copies 1785-93, not these pages (Bourdeau, 21 Sept 2026); the pages' real NA location is unknown.
alphabet: numeric groups 1-3264 (plus one 5100 and one 7205, misreads per Bourdeau); 2,585 groups, 931 distinct; max frequency 21 (group 460); 45.6 pct of groups above 900, 14.1 pct above 1500, 3.3 pct above 2500; per-hundred counts fall off above 1400

constraints.homophonic: no group reaches 1 pct of the text where French 'de' alone should be 4-5 pct (Bourdeau); frequent groups spread 35-2920
constraints.not_these_keys: Bourdeau (21 Sept 2026): not the Dedem 1788-93 code (crib overlap at chance), not Van Spaen 1808 or Fagel 1804 (different systems); DECODE holds no key; Roell's own papers NA 2.21.008.78 list Croiset (the ministry's code-maker) letters 1808-09 but no codebook
constraints.legation_key_items: NA 1.02.20 holds five key items, all digitised (EAD dao present), none in a series after 1785: inv. 17 (Colyer 1682-1725, z.d.), 164 (Hochepied, 'Sleutels cijferschrift, 1747', 78 scans), 628 (Dedel, 1764), 686 (De Weiler 1768-76, z.d.), 785 (Kroll 1784-85, z.d.). LIKELY-7, 2 Oct 2026.

judge.note: The row said 'judge nl'; the letter is French per DECODE and per its one clear word 'Monsieur' (Bourdeau), so the judge is fr1810 (1805-10 official French, era-matched; read tools/data/fr1810/README.md's fold spread before trusting a FAIL/PASS). No candidate reading exists yet, so the judge has not been run.
